settings.heading: How do I place an order?
settings.row_content: Choose a product and its options, add it to your cart, and continue to checkout. Review your items, delivery address, and contact details before submitting your order.

settings.heading: Where can I find shipping costs?
settings.row_content: Available delivery methods and shipping charges are shown at checkout. Read our Shipping Information page or contact us if you need more details.

settings.heading: How do I check my order status?
settings.row_content: Use the order status link in your confirmation email. If you need help, contact us with your order number.

settings.heading: Can I change or cancel my order?
settings.row_content: Contact us as soon as possible with your order number and the requested change. Whether we can adjust or cancel an order depends on its processing status.

settings.heading: How do I request a return or exchange?
settings.row_content: Read our Returns & Exchanges page, then contact us with your order number, product details, and the reason for your request.
